Uṇādikośa
Allahabad (U. sūtra k.). B. III. 36. Mithilā. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1911-12. p. 9 (no. 2111).

Uṇādikośa
Pt.. with the C. of Dayānanda Sarasvatī, under the title Vedāṅgaprakāśa, p.. xiii, Ajmer, 1896-1915. Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 244.

Uṇādikośa
by Vedānti Mahādeva (who composed his Viṣṇusahasranāmaṭīkā in A.D. 1694). [Page293-a.
Adyar D. VI. 800. Baroda 12905. BORI. 853 of 1886-92. 578 of 1899-1915. Hz. 1926 (Extr. Vol. III. p. 103). Peters. IV. 32. TD. 5678. Viśvabhāratī 1719.
Ed.. Mad. Uni. Skt. Ser. 21. 1956.

Uṇādikośa
gr. Bopadeva school; with C.
--by Rāma Tarkavāgīśa. IO. 874. L. 561. Oxf. 176 (2 mss., one with C.). SK. Ray. 334. 335. H. P. Sastri takes the a. of the U. kośa a. Rāmaśarman an. of the C. a. Rama Tarkavāgīśa. RASB. VI. Pref. lxxxvii.

Uṇādikośa
or lakSmInivAsAbhidhAna
--by Śivarāma Tripāṭhin of 18th cent. a. of Rasaratnahāra etc., son of Kṛṣṇarāma, son of Trilokacandra. AS. p. 29. L. 723 (same mss.). Mentioned among his other works in his Vidyāvilāsa, C. on Siddhānta Kaumudī. Adyar Library Bulletin. XV. 2. p. 64.
Pt.. 1873. See Ṣaṭkośasaṅgraha, Banaras 1873.

Uṇādigaṇavṛtti
Ref. in the C. Mañjūṣā by Hemahaṁsa on his Nyāyasaṅgraha (BBRAS. 76). C.. U. gaṇasūtra an. Vṛtti of Hemacandra.

Uṇādināmamālā
(C. 1400-50) by Śubhaśīla Gaṇi, disciple of Munisundara an. Lakṣmīsāgara. in 6 Khaṇḍas on the model of Hemacandra's Abhidhānacintāmaṇī. Br. Mus. 409. Chani 2971. 3521 (given anonymously). Jac. 696. Jainagranthāvalī p. 310. JBhP. I. 269.

Uṇādinighaṇṭu
Oppert I. 688. Likely to be same a. the next.

Uṇādinighaṇṭu
(in 720 v..) gr. lex. by Veṅkaṭeśvara, son of Dakṣiṇāmūrti of Kauṇḍinya gotra, disciple of Rāmabhadra [Page293-b] Dīkṣita an. patronised by Sāhaji, King of Tanjore (1684-1712).
GD. 2026 (inc.). Granthappura p. 95. (no. 2026 1-4 paricchedas). PUL. II. p. 110. TD. 4732.

Uṇādipadārṇava
See below Auṇādikapadārṇava.

Uṇādiprakaraṇavṛtti
by Amarasiṁha. JBhP. I. 268.

Uṇādipratyaya
with C. by Devanandin. Pannalal Bombay III. p. 38.

Uṇādimaṇidīpikā
Burnell 42a. TD. 5675 (inc.). See above C.s on Uṇādi sūtras.

Uṇādirūpāvali
by Mahāliṅga Śāstrin. Oppert II. 9286.

Uṇādilakṣaṇa
gr. Karkal 47 (inc.).

Uṇādisādhana
or sundaraprakAzazabdArNava by Padmasundara, pupil of Padmameru. Rep. Rāj. an. C. I. p. 44.

Uṇādisūtra

--by ‘Subodhinīkāra.’ Q. by Devarāja in his C. on the Nighaṇṭu (München 16).
